purpose: The one place that says what each kind of surface is made of: its fill, corner, edge and shadow. A recipe names a preset under "surface"; the generator lays the preset under the recipe's own styles, so a change here reaches every panel, tile or bar at once.

panel.purpose: A block that groups content: the flat slate fill and round corners. No edge, no shadow.

field.purpose: Somewhere you type or choose: the panel fill and corner, with the lit edge only, so it sits in the page.

tile.purpose: The frame around artwork in a grid or rail: round corners and a deep shadow. No edge.

poster.purpose: A card led by a photograph: the flat indigo fill and round corners, so it sits with the other panels. No edge, no shadow.

floating.purpose: Something that sits above the page for a moment, such as a toast or a pop-up card.

bar.purpose: A strip fixed to an edge of the screen: see-through and frosted, so content scrolls under it.

fill.purpose: A small filled mark, such as a quiet tag or an avatar with no photo: the panel grey and nothing else.

sheet.purpose: A pop-up card that sits above a dimmed page: the panel fill, large corners, a lit edge and the high shadow.

photo.purpose: A card that is all photograph: the poster's corners and shadow, and near-black behind the picture while it loads.

field-round.purpose: A field shaped as a pill, for one line you write and send: the chat composer.

marked.purpose: A block singled out from its neighbours, or a choice that is switched on: the ember shade. No outline.

glow.purpose: A warm halo around a small mark that has reached its highest level.

photo-fade.purpose: The foot of a photograph melting into the panel below it, so the picture does not end on a hard line.

button.purpose: The main button: a flat candle-gold fill with a soft warm glow beneath it, like a lit sign. No lip, no outline.

button-quiet.purpose: A second button or a small control: the lighter indigo fill, so it shows on a card as well as on the page. No lip, no outline.

control.purpose: A pill you can switch on: the flat slate fill, with no outline.

key-tile.purpose: A big answer you press: the flat indigo fill and large corners.
